mapper.select: SELECT A.PT_DLYS_SEQ AS pdNo, CASE WHEN A.PT_DLYS_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT Z.ADLY_BDWT FROM ODS.S_MRNNRHBD Z WHERE Z.PT_NO = A.PT_NO AND Z.PT_DLYS_SEQ = (A.PT_DLYS_SEQ - 1) AND Z.DLYS_TP_CD = 'B' AND Z.LST_YN = 'Y') END AS lastWeight, A.ADLY_BDWT AS todayWeight, CASE WHEN A.PT_DLYS_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL ELSE A.ADLY_BDWT - (SELECT Z.ADLY_BDWT FROM ODS.S_MRNNRHBD Z WHERE Z.PT_NO = A.PT_NO AND Z.PT_DLYS_SEQ = (A.PT_DLYS_SEQ - 1) AND Z.DLYS_TP_CD = 'B' AND Z.LST_YN = 'Y') END AS weightChange, A.PERI_ASDP_NM AS nrStfNm, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003030' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.PEM_DLFL_MNF_CMP_CD) AS company, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0000018' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.PEM_DLFL_CD) AS fluidType, PEM_DLFL_CNCT_UNIT_CD AS firstConcentration, TH2_PEM_DLFL_CNCT_UNIT_CD AS secondConcentration, TH3_PEM_DLFL_CNCT_UNIT_CD AS thirdConcentration, TH4_PEM_DLFL_CNCT_UNIT_CD AS fourthConcentration, A.PERI_SCHD_CNTE AS schedule, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0000019' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.PERI_KND_CD) AS dialysisType, A.PERI_CNTE AS message, A.GUID_CNTE AS urineVolume FROM ODS.S_MRNNRHBD A WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.PT_DLYS_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.DLYS_TP_CD = 'B' AND A.LST_YN = 'Y'
